item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera's teacher asks her to compare photosynthesis and respiration in the money plant growing near her classroom window. Which statement correctly compares the two processes?

options.A: Photosynthesis and respiration are two names for the same exchange of gases in the plant.
options.B: Photosynthesis makes glucose and releases oxygen, while respiration breaks down glucose with oxygen to release energy.
options.C: Respiration makes glucose and oxygen, while photosynthesis breaks down glucose to release energy.
options.D: Only the green leaves of the plant respire; the roots do not respire.
